shortDescription: Japan's exports rose 19.3% year-on-year to JPY 10,048.4 billion in August 2026, surpassing market consensus of 18.2%.Outbound shipments grew for the 12th month, lifted by robust demand for AI-related chips, despite risks from supply chain disruptions due to the Middle East conflict.

Outbound shipments grew for the 12th month, lifted by robust demand for AI-related chips, despite risks from supply chain disruptions due to the Middle East conflict.

title: Japan Exports Rise More than Expected
